verdict.rationale: An end-user consent dashboard is a fair question for an open-banking data and payments provider, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions consent incidentally: consent is part of storing bank details (docs-6), and verification compares data for accounts the user consented to (docs-29). Console is a merchant-side tool for payments, balances and team users. Nothing in the evidence shows a documented surface where end users view or revoke which apps hold access to their bank data.
